name: Mechatronics
summary: Integrating mechanics, electronics, sensors, actuators and embedded control into working electromechanical products.

topics.name: The mechatronic design approach and system integration
Electronics for mechanical engineers: diodes, transistors, op-amps and power stages
Microcontrollers and embedded programming: digital I/O, interrupts, timers
Interfacing: ADC/DAC, PWM and serial buses (I2C, SPI, CAN)
Sensors for mechatronics: encoders, Hall sensors, IMUs, force/torque sensors
DC, brushless DC and stepper motors: characteristics and drivers
Servo motor sizing and drive electronics
Solenoids, voice coils and other electromagnetic actuators
Power supplies and power electronics for mechatronic systems
Communication and networking of mechatronic devices
